compiled_state.title: UPDATE: Wire session-head sync into sub-agent dispatch protocol
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Update task-execution.md and worktree-dispatch.md to make SESSION_BRANCH/SESSION_HEAD injection and sync mandatory. Update the structural test to assert the new injection strings.

## Acceptance Criteria

**plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md:**
- Pre-Step: Git Root Verification section gains a new session HEAD sync block:
  - If SESSION_BRANCH and SESSION_HEAD are both set:
    - Call: bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/worktree-session-head-sync.sh"  # shim-exempt: internal orchestration script
    - Abort if exit code non-zero (sub-agent cannot continue on wrong commit)
  - If either is unset and IS_SESSION_WORKTREE=true: emit warning but continue (non-fatal for non-worktree orchestrators)

**plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/worktree-dispatch.md:**
- Remove the "known limitation / workaround" framing of bug 4724-41a7
- Make SESSION_BRANCH/SESSION_HEAD injection the mandatory injection protocol for all callers
- Add push step prerequisite: before injecting, caller must confirm session branch is pushed to origin
- Update Multi-Agent Callers (sprint) and Single-Agent Callers (fix-bug, debug-everything) sections

**tests/hooks/test-worktree-dispatch-orchestrator-root.sh:**
- Add assertions for new mandatory injection strings:
  - assert_contains "$content" "SESSION_BRANCH"
  - assert_contains "$content" "SESSION_HEAD"
  - assert_contains "$content" "worktree-session-head-sync.sh"

## File Impact

### Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md
- plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/worktree-dispatch.md
- tests/hooks/test-worktree-dispatch-orchestrator-root.sh

## Done Definitions

- [ ] task-execution.md Pre-Step calls worktree-session-head-sync.sh when SESSION_BRANCH and SESSION_HEAD are set
- [ ] worktree-dispatch.md mandates SESSION_BRANCH/SESSION_HEAD injection (not framed as workaround)
- [ ] worktree-dispatch.md includes push prerequisite for all callers
- [ ] test-worktree-dispatch-orchestrator-root.sh asserts SESSION_BRANCH, SESSION_HEAD, and worktree-session-head-sync.sh appear in worktree-dispatch.md content
- [ ] All existing assertions in test-worktree-dispatch-orchestrator-root.sh still pass
- [ ] No references to bug 4724-41a7 as a "known limitation" remain in worktree-dispatch.md (it is now the documented protocol)

## Retry Budget

Max 2 retry attempts. If structural test still fails: read actual vs expected strings carefully — whitespace and quoting matter.

GAP_ANALYSIS_AMENDMENT:

Two minor gaps identified by gap analysis — amend Done Definitions:

1. IS_SESSION_WORKTREE detection preservation:
   - The detection one-liner ([ -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.git" ]) MUST be preserved in worktree-dispatch.md when removing workaround framing
   - structural test (test-worktree-dispatch-orchestrator-root.sh) must assert both the detection block AND SESSION_BRANCH/SESSION_HEAD injection block are present

2. Structural test for task-execution.md Pre-Step:
   - Add assertion in test-worktree-dispatch-orchestrator-root.sh (or new test-task-execution-session-sync.sh) that task-execution.md Pre-Step contains the worktree-session-head-sync.sh reference and SESSION_BRANCH/SESSION_HEAD env-var contract
